# routes commands

Every `routes` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `routes:list`

List all discovered routes with source information.

```bash
bin/semitexa routes:list
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `routes:show`

Show detailed debug information for a specific route.

```bash
bin/semitexa routes:show "<id>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
